protocol.input: 16 real Eiger9M frames distributed across the 625-frame file; identical immutable float64 buffers for every variant; bottom-up orientation
protocol.settings: 2000 uniform 2theta degree bins, full pixel splitting, same mask, solid-angle normalization and polarization 0.965
protocol.matrix: Coefficients taken from the same Dioptrin LUT export. Removing masked entries preserves all other coefficient bits. CSC round-trip is checked coefficient-by-coefficient; no float32 conversion.
protocol.normalization: Same cached original-CSR denominators for all fast variants; same original strict denominators for both strict variants
protocol.execution: All timed integration is native Rust. Rayon pool size 1, 4 or 8; 16 frames processed in parallel. CSR also parallelizes across bins; CSC parallelizes across frames using a private histogram per frame.
protocol.measurement: Five warm blocks per variant/error mode, at least 1 s each; variant order rotates and reverses; each block gets one untimed warm batch. Includes output allocation, normalization and bin-axis construction. Excludes file IO, decompression, table construction and Python.
protocol.selection: The first 8-thread run had more competing CPU load. Its full results are retained in w8.json. The completed repeat w8-repeat.json is the primary eight-thread comparison; no measurements were deleted. CSV also reports medians for <=3.6 observed competing busy cores.
protocol.arithmetic: All pixels, weights, denominators, accumulators, intensities and errors are float64. Current/compacted CSR use the production four-lane FMA path. CSC uses either one accumulator per bin or four interleaved histograms with pairwise reduction. Strict CSR/CSC use separate multiply/add in matching pixel order.
protocol.poisson: Both signal and Poisson variance are accumulated in one table traversal. CSC computes squared float64 weights on the fly, without duplicating the integration matrix.
protocol.limits: Prototype cached-batch throughput on this detector/geometry. No HDF5/file throughput, cold-cache, one-image latency, 2D behavior, mask-update lifecycle, setup overhead or hardware performance counters measured. Histogram parallelism across frames is not a single-image parallel implementation.
